articles.summary: HOUSTON --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Feb. 24, 2026-- Murphy Oil Corporation (NYSE: MUR) is pleased to invite investors and stakeholders to a three-part webinar series highlighting the company’s offshore exploration and development strategy, with a specific focus on its growing Vietnam business.
articles.title: Murphy Oil Corporation to Host a Webinar Series Focused on the Company’s Offshore Strategy and Vietnam Business
